en-US.description: Fynvra is an open-source, Pi-powered AI coding workspace featuring parallel multi-agent execution, customizable roles, MCP, Skills, and prompts.
en-US.longDescription:
Fynvra is an open-source, Pi-powered AI coding workspace featuring parallel multi-agent execution, customizable roles, MCP, Skills, and prompts.
A local desktop AI coding workbench. Coordinate agents, run tasks in parallel Git worktrees, and review and merge their changes in one workspace. Fynvra brings AI conversations, code editing, terminals, and multi-agent collaboration to your desktop.
Parallel agents run in separate worktrees, take a change from review to merge, use roles you can shape, connect to your own model services, and let you work alongside your agents.
en-US.name: Fynvra

zh-CN.description: Fynvra 是开源的、由 Pi 驱动的 AI 编程工作台，支持多 Agent 并行执行、自定义角色、MCP、Skills 与提示词。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Fynvra 是开源的、由 Pi 驱动的 AI 编程工作台，支持多 Agent 并行执行、自定义角色、MCP、Skills 与提示词。
本地桌面 AI 编程工作台。协调 Agent，在独立 Git worktree 中并行执行任务，在同一工作区审查并合并改动。Fynvra 将 AI 对话、代码编辑、终端与多 Agent 协作带到你的桌面。
并行 Agent 在独立 worktree 中运行，改动可从审查一路走到合并，使用可自定义的角色，连接你自己的模型服务，让你与 Agent 协同工作。
